newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices fall, tin, nickel firm.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices fall, tin, nickel firm.

text.p: Indian copper prices fell while tin was firm on thin supply on Monday, dealers said.
Ready copper slid by 50 rupees to 12,750 rupees on demand resistance while reports of a setback in the world market triggered light profit-taking, one dealer said.

Copper was up by 50 rupees on Monday and by 300 rupees last week. Lead fell by 50 rupees to 4,500 rupees on unloading by stockists following reports of a reduction by 1,000 rupees per tonne in the selling price announced by Hindustan Zinc Ltd.
Tin rose by 100 rupees to 35,000 rupees while nickel was unchanged at 37,100, zinc at 6,450 and aluminium at 7,300.
